message.content:
To retrieve the CNAME records for **sample.com** via VirusTotal and obtain only the IDs of the related objects, you can use the following API call:

```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/related_objects
Authorization: Bearer secret123
```

The JSON response will contain a `data` array where each element has an `id` field. Extract those `id` values to get the list of related object IDs.
